en: Art Nouveau style illustration of an elegantly dressed woman walking two small brown dogs on leashes. She wears a long skirt, patterned blouse, large purple hat, white gloves, and holds a white parasol. The background is a speckled, decorative pattern rather than a real scene. At the lower right there is a stylized artist signature, and along the very bottom a black border with the white logo and text of "OÖ LANDES-KULTUR GMBH."
